info.title: Enterprise Strategy, Portfolio, Product, Project & Work Platform API
info.description: Generated from the resource registry and the live route table. All endpoints require authentication unless stated.

products.description: Products exist independently of projects and persist across many projects, releases and operational activities.

work_items.description: Unified work: project tasks AND operational/BAU work (incidents, requests, maintenance...). Operational work is never forced into a project.

cash_flows.description: Net cash flow per year, year 0 first, comma separated

tolerance_threshold.description: Severity at which impact becomes intolerable

framework.description: Reference only – a mapped control is not a compliance claim

investment_scenarios.description: What-if portfolio scenarios: include/exclude candidate projects and ideas and compare against funding and capacity limits.

ai_intakes.description: Paste notes or a brief; the assistant classifies it, asks clarifying questions and drafts brief, requirements, work and risks for human review.

requests.description: Intake pipeline for new projects, enhancements, operational improvements, compliance, infrastructure, product and emergency work.

ocm_impacts.description: Organisational change management – people/process/technology impacts on groups. Distinct from formal change requests (FR-OCM-010).
